context: Tests whether the agent rejects a confounded ETTrace result and constructs a controlled comparison.

checklist.name: Claim rejection
checklist.description: Explicitly rejects the reported 35% improvement as unsupported.

checklist.name: Build confound
checklist.description: Identifies Debug versus Release as an invalidating build-configuration difference.

checklist.name: Capture-mode confound
checklist.description: Identifies runtime capture versus launch capture as a distinct invalidating mode difference.

checklist.name: Thread-mode confound
checklist.description: Identifies single-thread versus multi-thread capture as a distinct invalidating scope difference.

checklist.name: Runner version
checklist.description: Records the ETTrace runner version as its own field and holds it fixed across the comparison.

checklist.name: Framework version
checklist.description: Records the linked ETTrace framework revision as its own field and holds it fixed across the comparison.

checklist.name: Cache state
checklist.description: Identifies warm versus cold cache state as invalidating and holds one data/cache state fixed.

checklist.name: Launch method
checklist.description: Identifies Xcode versus Home Screen launch as invalidating and uses the same Home Screen method for both sides.

checklist.name: Normalized contract
checklist.description: Defines one bounded search flow and controls architecture, simulator/OS, app data, user flow, and all previously identified dimensions.

checklist.name: Fresh symbol matching
checklist.description: Requires fresh architecture UUID-matched dSYMs for each rebuilt before/after app.

checklist.name: Clean run directories
checklist.description: Uses a fresh, empty artifact directory for every capture repetition.

checklist.name: Processed artifacts
checklist.description: Preserves the processed numbered output files together with the capture contract for each run.

checklist.name: Repeated evidence
checklist.description: Requires multiple runs for each version and reports run-level results or variance.

checklist.name: Thread-time meaning
checklist.description: Rejects the sum of multi-thread roots as wall-clock elapsed time.

checklist.name: Profiler routing
checklist.description: Routes broad delay localization to Instruments first when the slow subsystem or interval is still unknown.
